_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for production settings. Every tool reads this (promo.py enforces the rules, make_faces.py uses the lip-sync/footage settings). Change a setting HERE, never ad hoc. Each value records why/who decided.

realism_first.why: owner 2026-11-27: only do what is possible and realistic; nothing may give away that it's AI. Realism outranks cost, speed and effects. If a technique can't pass as real, we don't use it.

no_cutaway_while_talking.why: owner 2026-11-27: unnecessary cuts while talking not allowed

broll_only_between_lines.why: B-roll/canvas/photo only in beats between VO lines; overlays OK on face shots

max_zoom_on_talking_face.why: punch-ins up to 1.22x magnified lip-sync artifacts in v5 (owner rejected)

allow_reversed_footage.why: bounce/reversed head motion looked wrong in v5

max_beat_between_lines_s.why: keep pace tight; cutaway beats are short

rules.delegate_to_chatgpt: Owner 2026-11-27: save Claude tokens, use ChatGPT (python3 -m lane.chatgpt ask|research|image) at max. Send research, writing, reviews, analysis and image work to ChatGPT; Claude only directs, checks results and runs tools. Keep Claude replies short.

voice.why: only clone that sounded like the owner (ECAPA 0.51 vs Qwen 0.10 / Chatterbox 0.01); credits tight → 1 take

lipsync.why: owner picked TBDub best (option C) in the 4-way A/B on 2026-11-27

quality_gate.why: a clip must reach ≥90% of sync-3's sync confidence on the same line, or it's regenerated

baselines_2026_11_27.verdict: TBDub teacher on the small plate = 55-80% of sync-3 -> FAILS the 0.9 gate; owner also rejected by eye. Next: A/B on full-res original, LatentSync 1.6 on L40S full settings, X-Dub.
baselines_2026_11_27.note: syncnet needs >= 100 frames (4 s at 25 fps): pad/loop clips shorter than 4 s before scoring

latentsync16_modal_l40s_03_who.note: PASSES gate (>=6.89); same line TBDub 6.125. Clip: Modal ab --model latentsync16, 491 s GPU, ~$0.27. Awaiting owner's eye before switching config.

footage.why: continuous single-camera stretches with no burned subtitles (crop), no lower third, no camera cut

visuals.policy: find REAL references online (reachable: raw.githubusercontent.com), give them to ChatGPT with instructions; never use web images as-is and never pure AI-invented UIs

allowed_for: wide shots where the owner is not recognisable
generative_video.why: 2026-11-27 tests from a real frame: both I2V-A14B ($1.83, 16 fps) and TI2V-5B ($0.95, 24 fps) drift the owner's identity and ignore camera-move directions (brief: no synthetic-looking face)
generative_video.owner_preference: 2026-11-27: owner judged TI2V-5B 'much better' than I2V-A14B (smoother 24 fps, cheaper ~$0.95 vs $1.83)

inference_optimization.policy: always use the most resource-efficient setup that PASSES the quality gate (docs/optimization.md); never trade visible quality for cost

defaults.photo_to_video_model: REAL PHOTO + camera move (default). FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B FAILED the realism gate 2026-11-27; full TI2V-5B only for hero scenes after it passes the gate
defaults.lipsync_final: TBDub teacher (owner quality pick); try MagCache/Sage only via gate

not_possible.overclocking: no clock/driver control on cloud GPUs; per-second billing, so gains come from doing less work

fastwan_ti2v5b_3step_2026_11_27.cost: $0.19 for 8 clips (121 frames, 704x1280) on H100, 19 s/clip
fastwan_ti2v5b_3step_2026_11_27.why: after frame 0 it repaints the scene: different graffiti art, new giant flag/fortress, monastery reshaped, blurred number plate turned into an invented readable plate; saturated cartoon look. 40-73% of pixels change first->last frame (subtle motion should be ~10-20%).
fastwan_ti2v5b_3step_2026_11_27.check: first-vs-last frame diff map + % pixels changed >25 levels; anything >25% changed on a 'subtle motion' prompt = reject

realism_gate.applies_to: every AI-touched shot (lip-sync, Wan/FastWan animation, ChatGPT images) before it goes into any edit
checks: face identity vs the real source ≥ baseline (no drift, no 'different person' look)
lip-sync SyncNet LSE-C within 10% of the real-footage baseline; offset 0 ± 1 frame
AI-tell review: ChatGPT vision inspects 6 sampled frames per shot for tells (warped hands/text, waxy skin, melting background, flicker, identity change) → any 'likely AI' = reject
owner's eye is final; 'feels fake' = reject even if numbers pass
realism_gate.on_fail: drop the AI version and use the real footage/photo (plain or with a gentle real-camera-style move) instead; never ship a borderline shot

motion_rules.faces: never generated or re-animated beyond lip-sync; photos of people get camera moves (parallax/push), not invented body/face motion, unless the shot passes the gate
motion_rules.animation_strength: subtle, physically plausible only (light, crowd, water, flags, foliage, camera); no dramatic AI motion

final_cut._doc: Final-cut lab: every master (promo or trip film) goes through this on Kaggle's free 2x T4 before delivery. Run: python3 scripts/final_cut.py <master.mp4> --kind promo|trip [--spec ...|--expect ...]. Owner 2026-11-27: 'add a final cut review layer where a master final touch up lab works on kaggle'.

gpu_plan.gpu0: touch-up frames [0, 40%) -> Whisper large-v3 -> SyncNet on the master
gpu_plan.gpu1: touch-up frames [40%, 100%) -> join/encode/side-by-sides -> SyncNet on the touched cut
gpu_plan.cpu: technical QC in parallel (loudness, true peak, black, freeze, scene cuts vs speech, contact sheet)
gpu_plan.why: both T4s busy at once; Kaggle bills session time, not per GPU (LESSONS #43). First run with one lane per GPU left GPU0 at 3% mean util.

transcript.why: catches dropped/garbled VO words and wrong captions before the owner sees them

lipsync.note: tracks shorter than 100 frames (4 s @25 fps) can't be scored

cut_while_talking.why: hard rule no_cutaway_while_talking: a cut inside a spoken phrase next to a face shot = fail

contact_sheet.why: for the ChatGPT-vision AI-tell review + owner's eye (realism_gate)
contact_sheet.gpt_why: owner 2026-11-27: 'use gpt for feedback on generated content'. Runs here (CPU side) through lane/chatgpt.py on the owner's ChatGPT plan; skipped with a note if the Codex login isn't set up in this container.

not_for: trip (photos of people: camera moves only, realism_gate.motion_rules.faces)
face_detail.why: lip-synced mouths come out soft on the low-res plate; a LIGHT blend restores detail without the waxy GAN look

gate.owner_eye: required: the touched cut is a CANDIDATE (exports/<id>_touched.mp4 + side-by-side); it never replaces the master automatically

results.01_n8n_v6_2026_11_27_full_face: REJECTED by the gate: face SSIM p05 0.988 (ok) but SyncNet LSE-C dropped 3.2-6.4% on all 4 face shots (max 2%). Cause: GFPGAN redraws the lips. Fix: protect_mouth (mouth ellipse keeps the lip-synced pixels). 1,096 s on one T4 (1.3 fps) for 1,381 frames.
results.01_n8n_v6_2026_11_27_protect_mouth: STILL REJECTED, close: face SSIM p05 0.994; SyncNet LSE-C drop 0.9 / 1.4 / 1.1 / 3.5 % (max 2 %) -> 3 of 4 shots pass. Next try: a bigger mouth ellipse (mouth_w 1.3, mouth_h 1.0). Split over both T4s: 534 s + 716 s, whole session 1,097 s.

encode.why: candidate for the owner's A/B; encoded in parallel with the GPU on Kaggle's 4 CPUs. If adopted, it is the delivered file (CRF 14 = visually lossless).

fill_lab._doc: Pre-render gap-filling passes on Kaggle 2x T4 (jobs/fill-lab, clips split across both GPUs). Run: python3 scripts/fill_lab.py <clip-dir-or-files> --preset lipsync|hero_clip. Owner 2026-11-27: 'boost kaggle and use it for upscale or more render edits filling in gaps'.

lipsync.why: TBDub/LatentSync output 25 fps; the renderer's fps=30 filter repeats every 5th frame = judder on the talking face. RIFE makes real in-between frames.

hero_clip.why: Wan/FastWan clips are 24 fps 704x1280; trip films are 30 fps 1080x1920 (generative_video.photo_to_video.interpolation). Only for clips that already passed the realism gate.

interpolate.source: official link in github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE README (author recommends 4.25 by default)

not_for: owner's face (GAN upscalers paint skin; use final_cut face_detail, gated, instead)
upscale.gate: realism_gate + side-by-side; never auto-swapped into an edit

gate.how: for lip-sync clips: SyncNet before vs after (jobs/syncnet-eval on both dirs); interpolated clips are used only if LSE-C does not drop more than the max and the owner's eye agrees

encode.why: intermediate clip that the renderer re-encodes; near-lossless

01_n8n_v6_lipsync_rife_25to30_2026_11_27.verdict: REJECT: fails the SyncNet gate (max 2% LSE-C drop)
01_n8n_v6_lipsync_rife_25to30_2026_11_27.cost: 113 s Kaggle session for 6 clips (both T4s), $0
01_n8n_v6_lipsync_rife_25to30_2026_11_27.why: RIFE in-betweens blend mouth shapes; SyncNet confidence drops 4-11% and the offset moves 1-2 frames. Keep the renderer's frame repeat for lip-sync until a better candidate passes. Fill lab stays for no-face clips (hero_clip preset).
